result.summary: The front door lock is stiff but still locks and opens, so the property is secure and this isn't an emergency. On 18/11 the locksmith told the tenant he was on his way with two locks. By 19/11 nothing had been recorded about the visit, and nothing has come in since. I've emailed the locksmith and the tenant asking what happened, and put the ticket on hold with a chase due in 1 day. I haven't moved the stage because there's no proof the work was done.

On 18/11 he called to say he was on his way with two locks and the tenant said she'd stay in. Nobody has recorded what happened after that, and on 19/11 the agency logged 'No work results'. There are no landlord approvals, holds or attachments on file.
